readme_excerpt:
# apktool-diagnostics

**Comprehensive toolkit for stress-testing apktool (Android APK decompile/rebuild tool).**

Find real bugs in apktool through differential testing against real APKs, security pre-screening, framework compatibility checking, semantic dex diffing, and coverage-guided fuzzing setup.

## Why this exists

apktool is critical infrastructure: you point it at untrusted APKs and it processes them on your machine. When bugs hide in the decode/rebuild pipeline or in binary-format parsing, they affect everyone. This toolkit surfaces them.

- ✅ **Real-world testing** — validated against F-Droid client (round-trip passes, 1 residual edge case) and NewPipe (framework version failure correctly diagnosed)
- ✅ **Security focus** — built by reproducing CVE-2026-39973 (path traversal) end-to-end and confirming the fix
- ✅ **Found & fixed real bugs** — 2 bugs caught while building the tool itself (OOM in string-pool parsing, dict merge collision)
- ✅ **Not theoretical** — every claim traces to an actual test that could have failed

## Quick start

```bash
# Clone
git clone https://github.com/zowskyy/apktool-diagnostics.git
cd apktool-diagnostics

# Run a security scan
python3 apktool_diagnostics.py security-scan your-app.apk

# Test decode/rebuild round-trip
python3 apktool_diagnostics.py roundtrip apktool.jar your-app.apk ./work

# Or use the convenience script
bash examples/quick-start.sh your-app.apk
```

## What each subcommand does

### `security-scan <apk>`
Scans `resources.arsc`'s string pools for path-traversal patterns (`../`, absolute paths) *before* decoding — independent of which apktool version is used. Directly built from reproducing CVE-2026-39973.

**Sample output:** `CLEAN` (0 findings) on real F-Droid APK, correctly flags malicious `../../../etc` type names.

### `roundtrip <apktool.jar> <apk> <workdir> [--aapt2 <path>]`
Decodes an APK and immediately rebuilds it with zero edits, then diffs original vs. rebuilt at the entry level. Classifies every divergence as expected (signing metadata, resource renaming, SDK-qualifier pruning, XML line-number metadata) or a genuine anomaly.

**Sample result:** F-Droid client — 1119 entries, 0 unexplained anomalies after classification.

### `framework-check <apktool.jar> <apk> <workdir>`
Attempts decode+build; on failure, parses aapt2 errors and reports which framework version is needed instead of a raw Java stack trace.

**Sample result:** NewPipe — correctly diagnoses `android:defaultLocale` missing (API 35 framework required).

### `dex-diff <baksmali.jar> <orig_apk> <rebuilt_apk> <workdir>`
Independently disassembles `classes*.dex` and diffs the actual smali, not just byte-equality. Finds residual differences (like try/catch block merging) that are semantically equivalent but flagged for human review.

### `corpus <apktool.jar> <baksmali.jar> <aapt2> <workdir> name=path [...]`
Runs the full pipeline (security scan, round-trip, framework-check, dex-diff) across multiple APKs in one pass.
